text: Based on the evidence, **native forest was deforested here in 2025**. A 13.5-hectare area of tree-cover loss was observed in 2025, of which 13.1 hectares were confirmed as native forest (MGAP 2021). The loss area aligns with 98% forest cover in 2020 (JRC), meeting the corroboration rule. No planted forest was involved. The event area exceeds the minimum threshold (0.5 ha) and data coverage was complete (Hansen GFC).
